# Devwala

> Devwala teaches students and professionals to code through structured
> courses, hands-on projects, and mentorship — live online or in person at
> our centers in India.

Devwala teaches programming to students and working professionals and partners
with colleges, schools, and institutes to deliver industry-ready training.
Courses are available online and offline, with locations in Palwal, Faridabad,
and Delhi NCR.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://devwala.com/): Start here — learn to code online or offline
- [About](https://devwala.com/about): Who Devwala is and what it stands for
- [Services](https://devwala.com/services): All training programs offered by Devwala
- [Courses](https://devwala.com/courses): Catalog of 14 hands-on HTML5 and CSS3 courses
- [Contact](https://devwala.com/contact): Ways to reach Devwala

## Services

- [Technical Training](https://devwala.com/services/technical-training): Hands-on programming training — languages, frameworks, and real projects — online or at your campus
- [Faculty Development Program](https://devwala.com/services/faculty-development): Upskilling programs that help faculty teach modern development practices

## Courses (HTML5 & CSS3)

Beginner:
- [HTML5 Fundamentals](https://devwala.com/courses/html5-fundamentals): Tags, structure, and semantic elements — build a multi-page site by hand
- [CSS3 Styling Essentials](https://devwala.com/courses/css3-styling-essentials): Selectors, box model, colors, and typography
- [Responsive Web Design](https://devwala.com/courses/responsive-web-design): Media queries, fluid layouts, mobile-first thinking
- [Flexbox & Grid Mastery](https://devwala.com/courses/flexbox-grid-mastery): The two layout systems behind every modern website

Intermediate:
- [HTML5 Forms & Validation](https://devwala.com/courses/html5-forms-validation): Input types, validation, error states, accessible forms
- [CSS3 Animations & Transitions](https://devwala.com/courses/css3-animations-transitions): Hover states, keyframes, transforms — no JavaScript
- [Semantic HTML & SEO](https://devwala.com/courses/semantic-html-seo): Markup search engines and AI assistants can read
- [Web Accessibility](https://devwala.com/courses/web-accessibility): WCAG principles, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen readers
- [Typography & Color for the Web](https://devwala.com/courses/typography-color-web): Type scales, palettes, contrast, design tokens

Advanced:
- [CSS Architecture](https://devwala.com/courses/css-architecture): BEM, component styling, theming, Sass workflow
- [CSS-Only Interactions](https://devwala.com/courses/css-only-interactions): Tabs, accordions, modals with :has() and container queries
- [Landing Page from Design](https://devwala.com/courses/landing-page-from-design): Figma to production — pixel-accurate landing pages
- [Email HTML Development](https://devwala.com/courses/email-html-development): HTML emails that render in Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail
- [Portfolio Website Capstone](https://devwala.com/courses/portfolio-website-capstone): Plan, build, and deploy a portfolio site that gets interviews

## Who we train

- [For Colleges](https://devwala.com/for-colleges): Curriculum-aligned training, workshops, and placement preparation for college students
- [For Schools](https://devwala.com/for-schools): Age-appropriate coding fundamentals for school students
- [For Institutes](https://devwala.com/for-institutes): White-labeled technical programs and faculty support for training institutes

## Locations

- [Devwala in Palwal](https://devwala.com/location/devwala-in-palwal): Classroom training plus live online sessions in Palwal
- [Devwala in Faridabad](https://devwala.com/location/devwala-in-faridabad): Hands-on developer courses in Faridabad
- [Devwala in Delhi NCR](https://devwala.com/location/devwala-in-delhi-ncr): Weekend and weekday programs across Delhi NCR
